stance_rationale: Hard constraints and walk-forward schedule mostly pass, but the optimizer package relies on an unverified monthly-to-daily CVaR proxy and leaves No Silent Override, RF-A1 confidence sizing, PG2 TDC, and target covariance artifact verification unresolved.

method_shopping_audit.selection_method: Selected highest net_ir among turnover-admissible candidates; selected candidate also reports CVaR proxy pass.

sequential_admission_audit.integration_weight_breakdown: 80/20 design reported, but blended SR/MDD/IR and PG2 TDC are TBD by Forge.

critical_concerns.description: RF-O8 is not closed because selected CVaR pass uses cvar95_daily_proxy=0.0244 from monthly returns divided by sqrt(21), only 0.0006 below the 0.025 cap, with no direct daily selected-weight CVaR/MDD/stress path.
Charter §8 No Silent Override is incomplete: no optimizer_challenge_note.md or explicit open_questions artifact was found, while several items are deferred to Forge.
RF-O11 remains unresolved: inherited alpha RF-A1 subperiod stability failure is not translated into confidence-aware MVO, BL-prior shrinkage, or any use of confidence_vector in sizing.
Sequential Admission is not demonstrated: TDC vs PG2 is unavailable/TBD and the 80/20 integration scenario lacks blended SR/MDD/IR, so AX-008 verification triangulation cannot pass.

Required target covariance artifact is not auditable: qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260426_005 is absent and stage_artifacts/WT_D20260426_005/covariance.parquet is missing; only inherited WT_D20260425_010 covariance passes PSD/cond checks.
RF-O4 constraint sensitivity is not reported even though upper weight and max_names constraints bind; no bound-relaxed or unbounded concentration test is supplied.

supporting_arguments: RF-O5/RF-O6/RF-O7/RF-O13 pass on weights.csv: 213 dates, risk names 10-20, max risk weight 0.20, long-only min weight 0.001217, Σw max error 1.998e-15, turnover 4.7154 < 6.0.
RF-O9 is not triggered: weights.csv schema includes as_of_date, ticker, weight, method_selected, regime, and has 213 sig_dates from 2006-01-01 to 2023-12-01.
RF-O2 is not triggered by reported metrics: net_ir=0.6439 and estimated annual cost is proportional to turnover at 15bps one-way round-trip.
RF-O10 is partially controlled: exactly 10 candidates are reported and selected objective is net_ir, but CVaR is checked by proxy rather than used as a hard admissibility filter in code.
Risk inheritance Hill alpha is 2.7257, so RF-O12 heavy-tail MVO-alone trigger is not directly active; CRISIS/CAUTION pooled fallback and 0.10 max_w shrink are explicit.
unresolved_disputes: Whether monthly-to-daily sqrt(21) CVaR is acceptable evidence for a daily CVaR hard cap in KR tails.
Whether CASH at 0.30 is formally excluded from the [0,0.20] per-name weight bound under the hard mandate.
Whether inherited WT_D20260425_010 covariance artifacts are sufficient for WT-D20260426_005 when the target covariance.parquet is missing.
Whether Forge can produce PG2 TDC < 0.30 and blended 80/20 SR/MDD/IR before admission.
weakest_assumption: The weakest assumption is that cvar95_daily_proxy=0.0244, derived from monthly returns via sqrt(21), is sufficient proof that the selected walk-forward daily portfolio satisfies CVaR and MDD gates.
rebuttal_required: Produce direct daily selected-portfolio returns with exact weights, cash, regime switches, and costs; report daily CVaR95, MDD, stress windows, and issue infeasibility_report if any cap breaches.
Add optimizer_challenge_note.md with open_questions for Forge/Judge/Governor and explicit No Silent Override handling.
Show a confidence-aware sizing or BL-prior shrinkage ablation using confidence_vector to address RF-A1/RF-O11.
Compute TDC vs PG2 active book and 80/20 blended SR/MDD/IR before Sequential Admission.
Provide WT-D20260426_005 covariance artifact or per-sig_date Sigma PSD/condition audit proving cond <= 100 post-shrink.

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: The package is stronger than a single-snapshot optimizer because weights.csv is a real schedule, but AX-008 cannot pass while CVaR is proxied, PG2 admission is deferred, and target covariance/no-silent-override artifacts are missing.

optimizer_specific_questions: 이 weights를 22년 시계열에 적용 가능한가? weights.csv 기준 RF-O9는 낮지만 Forge handoff_note가 없다.
method_shopping에서 net_IR 1위가 direct daily CVaR-adjusted 기준에서도 1위인가?
RF-O8 CVaR cap은 월간 sqrt(21) proxy가 아니라 daily selected-weight path로도 통과하는가?
Sequential Admission vs PG2 active book TDC가 cross-section proxy가 아니라 portfolio time-series 기준으로 <0.30인가?
